products.name: OG Everyday Polo
products.tagline: Refined knit texture with a modern tailored drape
products.description: Crafted from 100% long-staple combed cotton knit with a subtle ribbed knit collar and understated placket. Cut for an easy, confident silhouette that bridges relaxed weekend leisure and polished evening dinners.
products.fit: Relaxed Tailored Fit. Model is 6’1” (185 cm) wearing size L.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out on gentle cycle. Lay flat to dry in shade. Warm iron if needed.

products.name: OG Pleated Relaxed Trousers
products.tagline: Single pleat front with an effortless fluid drape
products.description: A masterclass in proportions. Tailored with single deep forward pleats, an elasticated back waistband for hidden comfort, and wide-tapered legs that sit neatly over modern sneakers or classic loafers.
products.fabric: Tencel & Cotton Blend with soft micro-twill weave (280 GSM)
products.fit: Relaxed Straight Taper. Mid-rise with expandable waist.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended or gentle cold wash. Line dry. Steam press.

products.name: OG Essential Oversized Tee
products.tagline: Heavyweight 280 GSM boxy cut with clean collar bind
products.description: Engineered for true structure without feeling stiff. Cut with a dropped shoulder seam, wide ribbed collar band, and a generous boxy chest that hangs with substantial architectural presence.
products.fabric: 100% Carded & Combed Organic Cotton (280 GSM Heavyweight Jersey)
products.fit: Oversized Boxy Silhouette. True to size for intentional oversized aesthetic.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low.

products.name: OG Relaxed Oxford Shirt
products.tagline: Washed Japanese cotton weave with structured button-down collar
products.description: An uncompromising revision of the classic oxford cloth button-down. Garment-washed for broken-in softness from day one, with natural mother-of-pearl buttons and a gently curved hem designed to stay untucked.
products.fit: Relaxed Tailored fit with box pleat on back yoke.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash warm. Hang dry. Medium heat iron.

products.name: OG Minimal Bomber Jacket
products.tagline: Matte technical cotton shell with architectural lines
products.description: Stripped of all unnecessary military adornment, this bomber celebrates pure form. Features custom gunmetal two-way hardware, recessed tonal ribbed cuffs, and concealed snap welt pockets.
products.fabric: Water-Repellent Matte Cotton-Polyester Shell with Viscose Satin Lining
products.fit: Clean Boxy Fit with slight cropped waist.
products.careInstructions: Specialist dry clean only.

products.name: OG Heavyweight Basic Tee
products.tagline: Standard straight cut in garment-dyed deep charcoal
products.description: Your daily benchmark t-shirt. Dense 240 GSM organic cotton knit that maintains its crisp structure through hundreds of wears. Preshrunk with a reinforced twin-needle neck rib.
products.fit: Regular Relaxed Cut. True to size.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold with dark garments. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: OG Signature Co-ord Set
products.tagline: Matching relaxed overshirt and pleated bottom in tone-on-tone olive
products.description: A harmonized two-piece uniform. Features our signature relaxed utility overshirt cut from medium-weight micro-twill paired with matching relaxed pleated trousers for an instant, effortless outfit statement.
products.fit: Relaxed Tailored Two-Piece Outfit.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold or gentle machine cycle. Dry flat.

products.name: OG Ribbed Knit Slip Maxi Dress
products.tagline: Fluid column silhouette crafted from premium combed cotton rib knit
products.description: An effortless expression of warm minimalism. Features a flattering soft V-neckline, subtle vertical ribbing that contours naturally, and a clean ankle-skimming hem. Pair effortlessly with our minimal blazer or wear unadorned for relaxed evening elegance.
products.fabric: 95% Organic Combed Cotton, 5% Elastane (280 GSM Ribbed Knit)
products.fit: Slim Column Fit with natural comfort stretch. Model is 5’9” (175 cm) wearing size S.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold or gentle machine cycle. Dry flat in shade.

products.name: OG Cropped Utility Co-ord Set
products.tagline: Boxy cropped overshirt and high-rise pleated wide trousers in olive earth
products.description: Tailored precision meets relaxed utilitarian style. The cropped overshirt features twin chest flap pockets and horn buttons, paired with fluid high-waisted pleated wide-leg trousers for a sharp, confident uniform.
products.fit: Cropped relaxed top with high-rise wide-leg pants. Model is 5’9” wearing size S.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold gentle. Line dry. Warm iron.

products.name: OG High-Rise Straight-Leg Jeans
products.tagline: 13.5 oz washed ecru denim with clean straight drape and raw hem
products.description: Engineered from authentic Japanese non-stretch 100% organic cotton denim. Cut with a high waist that sits comfortably above the hip, a fitted rear, and relaxed straight legs that drape cleanly over minimalist footwear.
products.fit: High-Rise Straight Leg. Fitted at natural waist, relaxed through leg.
products.careInstructions: Wash inside out in cold water. Hang dry to maintain shape.

products.name: OG Minimal Wool-Blend Blazer
products.tagline: Oversized architectural silhouette in rich mocha brown
products.description: The cornerstone of the women’s tailoring capsule. Designed with dropped shoulders, subtle notch lapels, structured welt pockets, and a full satin lining for an imposing yet effortless drape.
products.fabric: 70% Fine Merino Wool, 30% Recycled Poly Blend with Viscose Satin Lining
products.fit: Intentional Relaxed Oversized Fit. Model is wearing size S.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only.

products.name: OG Heavyweight Boxy Cropped Tee
products.tagline: 260 GSM combed cotton with dropped shoulders and relaxed cropped hem
products.description: Cut wide through the body with a high-crew rib collar and a modern cropped length designed to hit precisely at the waistband of our high-rise trousers and jeans.
products.fit: Boxy Cropped Silhouette. True to size.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low.

products.name: OG Fluid Tailored Wide Trousers
products.tagline: High-rise double forward pleats in sand beige tencel blend
products.description: Architectural fluid movement. Crafted with deep forward pleats, invisible side slant pockets, and a fluid drape that cascades over sneakers or loafers.
products.fit: High-Rise Wide-Leg Relaxed Cut.
products.careInstructions: Gentle cold wash or dry clean.

products.name: OG Relaxed Washed Poplin Shirt
products.tagline: Lustrous breathable poplin with structured French collar
products.description: A staple button-down cut generously for versatile styling—tuck into tailored trousers, wear unbuttoned over a ribbed tank, or tie at the waist.
products.fabric: 80% Long-Staple Cotton, 20% Mulberry Silk Poplin (140 GSM)
products.fit: Relaxed Boyfriend Cut.
products.careInstructions: Hand wash cold or dry clean.

products.name: OG Minimalist Leather Shoulder Bag
products.tagline: Full-grain vegetable-tanned saddle leather in rich chestnut brown
products.description: Constructed from full-grain saddle leather with hand-burnished edges, custom matte gunmetal hardware, and an ergonomic shoulder strap designed for everyday utility.
products.fabric: 100% Full-Grain Vegetable-Tanned Cowhide with Cotton Twill Lining
products.fit: Dimensions: 28cm W x 18cm H x 8cm D
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean with soft damp cloth. Condition leather annually.

products.name: OG Vintage Arc Graphic Tee
products.tagline: Oversized 240 GSM combed cotton in cream with archival collegiate graphic
products.description: Express yourself. Wear your story. Inspired by vintage European sportswear archives, this relaxed tee features custom distressed water-based typography across the chest and dropped shoulders that hang effortlessly over washed blue denim.
products.fit: Relaxed Vintage Oversized Fit. Model is 5’9” wearing size S.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Hang dry in shade. Do not iron directly on print.

products.name: OG Studio Archive Oversized Tee
products.tagline: Heavyweight washed black streetwear tee with stark architectural typography
products.description: Relaxed fits. Everyday attitude. Cut wide and substantial with dropped shoulder seams and raw-edge sleeve finish. Crafted from dense 260 GSM jersey that holds a bold silhouette with zero clinging.
products.fit: Oversized Boxy Streetwear Cut. Model is 5’9” wearing size S.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold with dark colors. Line dry. Cool iron if needed.

products.name: OG Minimal Artifact Heavyweight Tee
products.tagline: Understated botanical emblem on heavyweight warm ivory cotton
products.description: Comfort meets understated style. A pure distillation of the OffGrid uniform aesthetic. Finished with a discrete line-art botanical graphic centered on the chest, a tight ribbed collar, and a smooth tactile handfeel.
products.fit: Relaxed Daily Silhouette with clean straight hem.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low or dry flat.

products.name: OG Boxy French Terry Sweatshirt
products.tagline: 420 GSM loopback cotton fleece with dropped shoulder lines
products.description: Substantial architectural weight with ultra-soft unbrushed loopback interior. Features clean ribbed cuffs, an athletic V-insert on the crew collar, and an oversized boxy silhouette that holds shape without sagging.
products.fabric: 100% Organic Cotton Heavyweight Loopback Fleece (420 GSM)
products.fit: Oversized Boxy Silhouette with dropped shoulders. True to size.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Flat dry in shade.

products.name: OG Minimalist Crewneck Sweatshirt
products.tagline: 380 GSM combed fleece with relaxed dropped sleeves in warm ivory
products.description: A refined everyday layer designed with subtle tonal stitching and tailored proportions. Soft brushed fleece lining provides cozy warmth while keeping an uncluttered editorial profile.
products.fabric: 100% Combed Ringspun Cotton Brushed Fleece (380 GSM)
products.fit: Relaxed Boxy Fit. Model is 5’9” wearing size S.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Do not bleach.

products.name: OG Heavyweight Ribbed Socks (3-Pack)
products.tagline: Cushioned organic cotton crew socks with arch support band
products.description: Knit from dense certified organic cotton yarn with targeted terry cushion underfoot and stay-up ribbing that leaves no compression marks. Sold as a convenient 3-pack in monochromatic neutrals.
products.fit: Unisex Ribbed Crew Fit. Elasticated arch support.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash warm with like colors.

products.name: OG Archival Canvas Tote Bag
products.tagline: 16 oz heavy natural duck canvas with reinforced handles and interior pocket
products.description: Rugged 16 oz unbleached cotton duck canvas that stands upright on its own. Designed with double-stitched bar-tacked handles, brass snap key loop, and clean internal organizer pocket.
products.fit: Dimensions: 40cm H x 36cm W x 12cm D. Handle drop: 28cm.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only with cold water and mild soap.

products.name: OG Washed Cotton Signature Cap
products.tagline: Low-profile unstructured 6-panel cap with antique brass buckle slider

products.name: OG Glyph Archival Oversized Graphic Tee
products.tagline: Heavyweight 280 GSM combed cotton with high-density architectural glyph screen print

products.name: OG Raw Hem Plain Oversized Tee
products.tagline: 260 GSM organic cotton with relaxed dropped-shoulder drape and clean blind hem
products.description: The quintessential everyday streetwear tee. Crafted from 100% carded organic jersey cotton with double-needle collar stitching and a relaxed drape that falls straight through the torso.
products.fit: Signature Relaxed Oversized Fit. Size down for regular fit.
products.careInstructions: Cold wash with like colors. Tumble dry low or line dry.

products.name: OG Heavyweight Boxy Cut Tee
products.tagline: Structured 300 GSM combed jersey with wide sleeves and cropped torso proportions
products.description: Tailored with architectural proportions: wide, boxy body paired with a slightly cropped length that sits cleanly at the belt line. Heavy 1.25-inch rib-knit crewneck collar that never sags.
products.fit: Boxy Wide-Shoulder Silhouette. Torso length slightly cropped.

products.name: OG Relaxed Camp Collar Poplin Shirt
products.tagline: Breathable washed cotton poplin with relaxed open camp collar and straight hem

products.name: OG Heavyweight Oversized Pullover Hoodie
products.tagline: 450 GSM diagonal loopback French terry with double-layered crossover hood

products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended or machine wash cold gentle cycle.

products.name: OG Heavyweight French Terry Joggers
products.tagline: 400 GSM brushed fleece with extended drawstrings and concealed zipper ankle gussets
products.description: Designed for daily uniform wear with an elevated aesthetic. Heavy custom-knit cotton terry, deep welted side pockets with concealed security zips, and thick elasticated ankle cuffs.
products.fit: Tapered Relaxed Street Silhouette with Elasticated Cuffs.

products.name: OG Technical Field Zip Jacket

products.fit: Boxy Outerwear Fit. Designed for effortless under-layering.

products.name: OG Studio Typographic Oversized Tee

products.description: A feminine relaxed cut featuring generous dropped shoulders and extended sleeves that hit just above the elbow. Washed in natural mineral tones for an authentic vintage hand-feel.
products.fit: Slouchy Relaxed Fit with Extended Drop Sleeves.

products.name: OG Seamless Heavy Rib Crop Top
products.tagline: Sculpting wide-rib stretch modal knit with crew neckline and clean banded hem
products.description: An essential layering staple. Crafted from ultra-dense modal-cotton ribbing that contours comfortably without constriction. Clean self-bound neckline and finished crop length that pairs seamlessly with high-rise bottoms.
products.fit: Fitted Contoured Silhouette. Cropped right above high waistband.
products.careInstructions: Cold gentle machine wash. Lay flat to preserve rib elasticity.

products.name: OG Fitted Mockneck Long Sleeve Top

products.name: OG Boyfriend Oversized Poplin Shirt

products.description: Borrowed-from-the-boys proportion perfected for women. Designed with dramatic dropped shoulders, deep box pleat at back, mother-of-pearl buttons, and an elongated curved hem ideal for loose styling.
products.fit: Generous Boyfriend Oversized Fit. Elongated drape.
products.careInstructions: Warm machine wash. Iron medium heat while slightly damp.

products.name: OG Cropped Raw-Edge Fleece Hoodie
products.tagline: 420 GSM brushed organic fleece with dropped shoulders and relaxed cropped hem
products.description: Cozy warmth meets sharp street aesthetic. Cut with wide sculptural sleeves, a double-lined crossover hood, and an unfinished roll hem that hits comfortably above the hip.
products.fit: Cropped Boxy Silhouette. Wide sculptural sleeve drape.
products.careInstructions: Cold wash gentle. Dry flat in shade. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: OG High-Rise Column Wide Trousers
products.tagline: Fluid tailored crepe with deep front pleats, slant pockets, and clean floor-grazing length
products.description: Architectural tailoring engineered with a flattering high waist, structured front waistband, and wide parallel legs that fall in clean, dramatic folds.
products.fit: High-Rise Column Wide-Leg. Floor-skimming hem.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean or delicate cold wash in wash bag. Hang to dry.

products.name: OG Parachute Utility Cargo Pants
products.tagline: Lightweight crisp technical cotton-nylon with knee pleats and toggle hems
products.description: Modern streetwear silhouette infused with utilitarian edge. Features an elastic bungee waistband, deep bellowed cargo pockets, and adjustable ankle toggles that convert from relaxed wide leg to balloon taper.
products.fit: Convertible Parachute Fit. Adjustable elastic bungee waist and cuffs.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold gentle. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: OG Minimalist Linen-Blend Co-ord Set
products.tagline: Matching boxy short-sleeve shirt and high-waist relaxed tailored shorts in earthy olive
products.description: An effortless two-piece warm-weather uniform. Features a cropped camp-collar button shirt paired with matching pleated elastic-back trousers crafted from a tactile linen-tencel weave.
products.fit: Tailored Relaxed Fit Two-Piece Set.
products.careInstructions: Gentle cold machine wash. Hang dry in shade. Warm iron.

products.name: OG Monolith Coordinates Unisex Graphic Tee
products.tagline: 280 GSM combed cotton with subtle monochrome architectural coordinate typography
products.description: Understated street philosophy in physical form. Minimalist typographic coordinates printed on heavy combed cotton jersey with seamless tubular sides and twin-needle hems. Universally flattering unisex drape.

products.name: OG Studio Boxy Crewneck Sweatshirt
products.tagline: Plush 400 GSM unbrushed cotton fleece with dropped shoulder seams and thick ribbed collar
products.description: The essential unisex layer for cool days. Clean, unbranded aesthetic that pairs effortlessly with tailored trousers or denim. Pre-washed to eliminate shrinkage.
products.fit: Oversized Relaxed Fit with Dropped Armholes.
products.careInstructions: Gentle wash cold. Line dry in shade.

products.name: OG Relaxed Easy Drawstring Trousers
products.tagline: Dense cotton-twill with elasticated drawstring waist and straight tailored leg
products.description: The bridge between tailored elegance and street comfort. Features a comfortable elastic waist with natural cotton drawcord, deep side pockets, and a clean straight leg that stacks effortlessly over boots or trainers.
products.fit: Relaxed Straight Cut with Flexible Elastic-Drawstring Waist.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Tumble dry low.

products.name: OG Uniform Heavyweight Basic Tee
products.tagline: 280 GSM single-jersey combed cotton with high-density ribbed collar that holds shape
products.description: A foundational piece built for longevity. Knitted with zero lateral seams, reinforced shoulders, and dense combed cotton yarns that develop a richer character with every wash.
products.fit: Standard Relaxed Unisex Silhouette.
products.careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside out. Tumble dry low or hang dry.

products.name: OG Archival Modular Tactical Vest
products.tagline: High-density Cordura nylon vest with MOLLE webbing, 5 utility pockets, and side buckle straps
products.description: A statement streetwear layering piece. Engineered with tactical quick-release side buckles, heavy-duty metal zippers, hidden interior passport pouch, and ventilated back panel. Worn effortlessly over tees or hoodies.
products.fabric: 500D Technical Cordura Nylon with Breathable Air-Mesh Back
products.fit: Adjustable Tactical Vest. Side compression straps fit sizes XS through XXL.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean with damp cloth. Do not machine wash.

reviews.comment: The collar holds its structure perfectly, even after multiple washes. The olive tone has this subtle richness that looks significantly higher-end than standard fast fashion.
Best trousers I own. The single pleat gives incredible movement and the fabric drapes like a tailored Japanese pair. Fits true to size.
Heavyweight 280 GSM cotton is legitimate. No see-through, thick neckline ribbing that does not bacon-wave. Clean minimalism at its best.

settings.announcementText: Complimentary shipping across India on orders above ₹1,999 · Discover the Everyday Uniform
settings.brandStoryCopy: OffGrid OG was founded on an uncompromising principle: modern style should feel inherently your own. We craft a disciplined wardrobe of versatile essentials, clean silhouettes, and tactile fabrics that exist outside fleeting trends—giving you room for true individuality.
settings.campaignSubhead: Considered silhouettes. Versatile layers. Pieces that work effortlessly on your terms.
